title: Decode a transported capture
responsibility: Decodes transported artifact bytes and checks the supplied length and hash.

inputs.name: binaryArtifact.value
inputs.description: A transported binary record with base64 data, its encoding, decoded byte length, SHA-256 digest, and media type. Decoding accepts only the base64 encoding and string data, then checks the decoded length and lowercase SHA-256 digest; the wrapper also requires a string media type.

outputs.name: binaryArtifact
outputs.description: Resolves to the decoded Uint8Array together with the supplied media type and SHA-256 digest. The result is returned only after the decoded length and digest match the transported values.

errors.name: Binary artifact decode or integrity failure
errors.description: Throws Error("The computer sent media this app cannot read.") when the encoding or data cannot be decoded, or when mediaType is not a string. Throws Error("The media arrived damaged and is not shown.") when the decoded byte length or SHA-256 digest differs from the supplied value.
